author: Jason Stys
summary: Compare verified runtimes across shared held-out clean, noise, occlusion and dim conditions with per-class recall, calibration and explicit configurable failure gates.
rationale: Supports deployment tradeoffs using the same evidence rather than incompatible aggregate timing or accuracy claims.
limitations: Synthetic 8x8 shapes only; no camera, people or safety-critical deployment qualification.
Timing is host-specific, memory tracing is Python-only and energy uses an assumed-wattage proxy rather than measured power.
Quality gates use controlled held-out conditions; they are not certification of arbitrary model/runtime combinations.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
